description: Implements state elimination on a GNFA to convert DFA to regular expression. Helper functions handle regex union, concat, star with None as empty language. dfa_to_regex builds GNFA with new start 's' and final 'f', eliminates states in given order using R'_ij = R_ij | R_ik (R_kk)* R_kj. Three examples tested against DFA on all strings up to length 8.

steps.description: Imports and EPS constant for epsilon (empty string).
union function: handles None as empty language, returns other operand if one is None, avoids duplicate 'r|r'.
group function: parenthesizes unless length <= 1 (single symbol or epsilon).
concat function: returns None if any part is None (kills path), concatenates with grouping for top-level unions.
star function: returns EPS for None or EPS (since empty* = epsilon), otherwise groups and adds *.

dfa_to_regex: builds GNFA dict R mapping (from,to) -> regex. Adds edges from delta (merging parallel with union). New start 's' -> start with EPS. Each accept state -> 'f' with EPS. Eliminates states in order: computes loop = star(R_kk), updates all i,j pairs with concat(R_ik, loop, R_kj) unioned with existing R_ij. Prints each new edge. Returns edge('s','f').
Elimination core: for each state k in order, remove from alive, compute self-loop star, update all surviving pairs (i,j) with paths through k. Filter R to keep only alive states.
run_dfa: simple DFA runner for verification. Follows delta, returns False on missing transition, checks accept.
EXAMPLES dict: three DFAs with states, delta, start, accept, elimination order. 'a*b' (2 states), 'even a's' (2 states), 'ends in ba' (3 states).
Test loop generates all strings over {a,b} up to length 8. For each example, runs dfa_to_regex, compares regex fullmatch against run_dfa on all test strings, prints regex and agreement boolean.

title: DFA to Regex via State Elimination (GNFA)
